row.name: Patient action row
row.description:
Patient action row. The patient-level actions that production ships in the Facesheet header, moved into a distinct band directly below the patient header. COMPOSITION IS PRODUCTION, UNCHANGED - only position changed. The modal test that earlier scoped this row was WITHDRAWN 2026-08-20 after Phase 0 showed it selected almost the inverse of the list it was attached to: of the six actions it was meant to admit, only Send Patient Education actually opens a modal.

VISIBLE, left to right: New Note (split), AI Note Assist, Collect Payment ($0.00), Print. More sits at the right edge and carries all EIGHT: Send Secure Message, Send Patient Education, Health Data Exchange, Export Immunization Data, Export Health Surveillance Data, Import Summary of Care, Export Referral, Export Continuity of Care. Labels verbatim from clinical-system/src/types/header.ts:50-59.

GEOMETRY, DERIVED NOT AUTHORED. Height 56 = 36 + 10 + 10. The 36 is the tallest control in the row - a Button Text Medium, which is what Print and More resolve to because production sets no size prop on either. The 10/10 is the patient header band's own vertical padding, reused so the two bands agree. The 56 matches the working estimate but was not taken from it. Horizontal padding 16, also the header's. Gap 16 between actions = the Stack spacing lg:2 in HeaderRightLinks.tsx:109.

WIDTH. Master 900 with minWidth 900, mirroring the patient header exactly: a master cannot fill at the top level, so instances are set to fill when placed. On the control screen the instance is 1184, matching the header instance edge for edge.

SIZES ARE PRODUCTION'S, INCLUDING ITS INCONSISTENCY. Collect Payment, AI Note Assist and both New Note halves are size=small; Print and More are medium because production passes no size. That is why Print reads larger than Collect Payment beside it. Reproduced, not corrected - the instruction was to change position only.

NEW NOTE KEEPS ITS PRIMARY. Two Button group / Segment instances, Contained Secondary Small, Position First and Last. That coral is not a choice made here: MuiButtonGroup.defaultProps is {variant: contained, color: secondary} in ButtonGroupOverrides.ts:5-6, and CreateNoteButton passes no variant. The split contains PRACTICE-CONFIGURED NOTE TYPES fetched by getPracticeNoteTypes - note type selection happens in this row, not on Notes. See ACTION-ROW-PATIENT-PHASE0.md P0.d.

AI NOTE ASSIST IS CONTAINED PRIMARY, WHICH IN THIS THEME IS WHITE. ButtonOverrides.ts:40-44 gives containedPrimary a common.white background with a 1px core.main border, not a teal fill. The white pill is correct and matches production.

ICON GAP, NOT A DESIGN DECISION. Print and AI Note Assist ship WITHOUT their production icons. The library file holds 76 icon masters but only FIVE are published and importable into a consuming file: DownCaret, PlusOutlined, CloseOutlined, TrashOutlined, LinearEllipsis. Icon/PrintOutlined exists at 575:26 and cannot be imported. Production uses PrintOutlinedIcon on Print and Book4SparkSharp from @mui-symbols-material/w400 on AI Note Assist - the latter has no library equivalent at all. Nothing absurd was substituted. New Note keeps its plus and both carets are real, because those three are among the five published.

COLOUR. Ground color/background/paper, 1px inside bottom rule color/divider - the same two tokens and the same treatment the patient header band uses. Every paint in the row is variable-bound; the button colours come from the Button set. Padding and gap are raw integers, matching the header, which also leaves its 10/16 unbound.

NOT RESOLVED, recorded on instruction: whether this row persists across all seventeen destinations or appears only where it earns 56px; whether New Note and AI Note Assist are page actions belonging to Notes rather than patient actions; what is inside the legacy Exchange menu. Page actions (+ Problem, + Vitals, Create Order, Add Member, + Upload) belong with each destination heading and are NOT here.
